The Silicon Valley Archives

A survey of 1,901 collections held at Stanford University, arranged by the period each one documents.

Every title, call number, extent, date span and description here is the library’s own cataloguing. Collections the catalogue does not describe are listed by title alone rather than described at second hand, and each one links to its catalogue record.

Collections are placed by what they are about rather than by when they were made, so an oral history recorded in 1980 about the 1860s is filed under the 1860s. A collection that documents more than one period appears under each of them, which is why the totals below come to more than 1,901. Within a period a collection is listed under one subject only, and some are listed under none at all: the catalogue does not always say what a collection is about.
